headline: IDX Revokes Licenses of 4 Securities Firms in 2026, Here Is the List
summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange revoked the licenses of four securities firms in 2026, including PT Paramitra Alfa. Broker suspensions have affected capital market activity.
why: Brokerage licenses determine which firms can trade on the exchange, and revocations affect market access and investor protection.
original_headline: BEI Cabut Izin 4 Sekuritas Sepanjang 2026, Ini Daftarnya
